Column spacing is provisionally divided evenly within the previous outer envelope. Interior furniture and decoration still include generic illustrations and cannot establish this palace's surviving furnishings, uses, or former residents.
messages.中央帘罩、梢间北部炕罩及深木低座、五扇素屏关系参考官方图文。柱距、门洞、家具尺寸: The relationship between the central curtain partition, kang-bed enclosures and dark-wood low platforms in the north of the end bays, and the five-panel plain screen is based on official text and images. Column spacing, door openings, furniture dimensions, and opening states are fitted, not historical door states or a complete inventory of current conditions. Screen imagery, feather fans, cranes, and hanging lamps have not been precisely replicated.
messages.明间东喜鹊登梅、西藤萝松缠枝落地罩与两侧次梢隔扇按官方文字区分。当前仅表示木框和: The central bay's east floor-standing partition with magpies and plum blossoms, west partition with wisteria and intertwined pine branches, and lattice partitions in the adjacent and end bays are distinguished using official descriptions. The model shows only wooden frames and openness, not the original carvings. Openings serve model viewing and do not represent historical or present-day opening states. The central throne remains a generic illustrative placeholder; the complete throne screen, incense stands, and court fans await verification.
messages.庭院中央表现现存未完工灵沼轩遗存，不是已毁的旧延禧宫正殿。石构与铁构轮廓参考官方: The center of the courtyard depicts the surviving unfinished remains of Lingzhao Pavilion, not the destroyed main hall of the former Yanxi Palace. Stone and iron outlines follow official images. Exact dimensions, subsidiary building lengths, and connections still require survey verification.

messages.三座门洞、七座顶楼及琉璃/白石主要分区有官方依据；门洞净宽、台座线脚、纹样和各构: The three gateway openings, seven roofed towers, and main divisions of glazed surfaces and white stone are supported by official sources. Clear gateway widths, base moldings, patterns, and component dimensions remain model fits.
messages.匾联层次试配 · 部分待核: Trial plaque and couplet layering · Partly unverified
messages.六根贴金柱及四对陈设类别有官方文字依据；本版将横匾移挂现有前排梁，保留匾联尺寸、: Official text supports the six gilded columns and four pairs of furnishing types. This version moves the horizontal plaque to an existing front beam while retaining plaque and couplet dimensions, the column grid, and the ceiling. Its precise hanging position is a photo-based depth fit, not surveyed. Look upward at close range; overall perspective proportions still differ.
messages.五间面阔、明间五扇寿字屏风与大圆宝镜匾、东竹纹与葡萄罩、西玉兰与玻璃隔扇及西梢暖: The five-bay frontage, central five-panel longevity-character screen and plaque with a large round mirror, east bamboo-pattern and grapevine partitions, west magnolia and glazed lattice partitions, and west end warm chamber follow official text and images. Partition opening widths, furniture sizes, and warm-chamber positions are reversible fits. Decorations represent types, not exact copies of actual carvings.
messages.五进深与前后廊 · 尺度拟合: Five depth bays with front and rear verandas · Fitted dimensions
messages.中央屏风、宝座前案及蓝色陈设参考故宫官网照片；照片拍摄日期和单件器物身份尚未核定: The central screen, table in front of the throne, and blue furnishings are based on photographs on the Palace Museum website. Photo dates and individual object identities are not yet verified. The ceiling, screen panels, and patterns below the plaque are original AI-assisted approximations, not exact copies of surviving carvings. Five depth bays use six column stations; the 56 columns and front and rear veranda depths of 3 meters are reasonable fits for this version, not official measured column counts or dimensions. Official sources support omitted columns in the front central bay and through passages at both ends. Furnishing dimensions still require alignment. The central furnishing platform is not open as a walking route in the model.

messages.午门南、北面均有中部门洞的资料依据；南侧通路应辨别柱内前后檐廊和柱外窄带。模型保: Sources support central openings on both the south and north faces of Wumen Gate. The south-side passage requires distinguishing the front and rear eaves verandas inside the columns from the narrow strip outside them. The model retains the original outer column grid, roof, and gate platform, with the inner enclosure set back to show the front and rear verandas. The adopted 2.9 m is an estimated column-axis-to-enclosure-axis distance aligned to the published column-grid depth using design and section drawings from the same 2005 report. The modeling range is approximately 2.6–3.2 m, not an on-site measured clear width. Gateway widths, door-leaf details, and some inner columns remain provisional.
messages.午门正楼现以六条纵深柱轴表达五进深：内柱距中轴约 3.2 m 为图纸配准值，并非: Wumen Gate's main tower now represents five depth bays with six longitudinal column axes. The inner columns' distance of approximately 3.2 m from the central axis is aligned from drawings, not measured. The nine transverse bays retain the model's equal division. North and south enclosures are represented bay by bay across the nine bays. Individual leaf counts, detailed door and window types, and real-world opening states are not yet verified. Only the central doorway is open for model preview. Hidden gable-wall columns and the complete timber frame are unfinished. Fixed interior fittings remain unknown. The present floor, ceiling, and columns are simplified previews, not copies of temporary exhibitions or permission to visit on site.
messages.神武门四周有廊，南北面明间及左右次间设菱花隔扇门，东西面设双扇板门。模型柱网参考: Shenwu Gate has verandas on all four sides. The central and adjacent bays of its north and south faces have diamond-lattice doors; its east and west faces have double-leaf plank doors. The model's column grid references published survey data from the 2005 conservation project, distinguishing the tower's column grid, hall-platform outline, and outer gate platform. The reported gate-platform dimensions of 50.18 × 26.46 m do not clearly specify measurement to the platform top, base, or parapet. This round provisionally uses them for the top extent and cannot claim to reconstruct actual clear passage widths.
messages.神武门原有全局位置保留，已知定位核对仍有 11 m 差异。城楼仍采用简化的同高地: Shenwu Gate retains its original global position, with a known 11 m discrepancy remaining in the position check. The tower still uses a simplified level floor. The height difference between the hall platform and gate-platform top, vertical dimensions of steps on all four sides, and roof elevation have not been calibrated to measured data. Open doors and passable routes in the model serve the experience and do not indicate today's on-site access permission.

messages.钦安殿保留地面观览落点，可沿东西侧台阶进入抱厦与主殿，再从同侧原路返回；不提供穿: Qin'an Hall retains a ground-level viewing destination. Use the east or west side steps to enter the projecting porch and main hall, then return along the same side. No northward shortcut through the hall is provided. Open side doors are an interpretation for gameplay; doorway and door-leaf dimensions are model fits and do not indicate on-site public access. The main hall's five-bay column grid and layered elevations reference survey research. The roof skin, porch height, platform, and railing thickness remain approximate. Drawing evidence of a continuous north wall does not establish today's access controls.
messages.南侧轴线复合石构因层次证据未明而暂未建模；天一门、围院、完整室内木构及重建后抱厦: The composite stone structure on the south axis is not yet modeled because evidence for its layering is unclear. Tianyi Gate, the courtyard enclosure, the complete interior timber frame, and the rebuilt porch's details also remain unverified. messages.本轮外观：局部实际更新；内饰：局部实际更新。保留原屋顶、台基、GLB框架不漂移，: This round: exterior partly updated; interior partly updated. The original roof, platform, and GLB frame are retained without shifting. messages.本轮外观：局部实际更新；内饰：局部实际更新。三主开间各细分为九格方柱立面，窄/宽: This round: exterior partly updated; interior partly updated.
